hook: Predict the result, then reveal the model.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: When ammonia acts as a Brønsted–Lowry base in water, which ion forms when it accepts a proton? Ammonia can accept a proton from water, forming ammonium and hydroxide. The reaction is reversible and the arrow shows the forward direction only.
